text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-86088, Rod Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair

The Rustic Sandcast Bronze Back-to-Back Pull Set feels like the old world. Everything from it's traditional design to the bronze material from which it is made makes the Rod Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair the perfect finishing touch to your historic home. It is available with an 8 inch or a 12 inch center to center length. Choose from matte black, medium bronze, and tumbled white bronze finishes. The Rose Bronze Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair comes packaged as a set of 2 pulls and the mounting hardware. It will fit doors 1-3/8 inches to 2-1/4 inches thick.

Sandcasting is a process for casting metal in sand molds. The mold is made by packing the sand around a pattern. Molten bronze is then poured into a mold cavity formed out of sand. Each sand mold is used only once. The sand is then recycled for the next piece.

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: Rod Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Rustic Rod Sandcast Bronze Pull Set:

  • Material: Sandcast Bronze
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.

Available in 2 Sizes:

    EMT-BTB-86088:
    • Center to Center Length: 8"
    • Total Length: 9-13/16"
    • Pull Handle Width: 3/4"
    • Total Projection: 2-9/16"
    • Base: 1-13/16"

    EMT-BTB-86068:
    • Center to Center Mount: 12"
    • Total Length: 13-3/4"
    • Pull Handle Width: 3/4"
    • Total Projection: 2-9/16"
    • Base: 1-3/4"
    • Clearance: 1-3/4"

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
